description: Potentieel gebied met grondwater voor de bereiding van drinkwater (OGV, 2010) (historie) is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Provinciale Staten van Drenthe hebben op 7 juli 2004 het Provinciaal Omgevingsplan Drenthe II vastgesteld. Hierin is op kaart 11 het potentieel gebied met grondwater voor de bereiding van drinkwater aangegeven. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are omgevingsvisie. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/PNG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/ZIP. The portal shows 2024-10-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
